verbalization: The compound (3R,4S,6S)-10,13-dihydroxy-3-methoxy-6-methyl-5-oxapentacyclo[9.7.0.02,8.04,6.012,17]octadeca-1,8,10,12(17),13,15-hexaene-7,18-dione is associated with CWR22R through multiple pathways. In one pathway, it is predicted to interact with Mycalenitrile 13, which in turn targets CWR22R. In another pathway, it is predicted to interact with the sodium/bile acid cotransporter, which is targeted by Acorone, also leading to CWR22R. These findings suggest that the compound may influence CWR22R through different molecular mechanisms, potentially involving receptor activation or transport-related pathways. The evidence is consistent across two distinct targets, indicating a possible role in modulating CWR22R function. The strength of the evidence is moderate, with scores of 0.6325 and 0.6228, suggesting that the relationship is supported but not definitively conclusive. The mechanisms involve receptor-targeting and transport-mediated interactions, which may be relevant in understanding the compound's biological effects.
